runtime.tenant_source: FrontendContext.tenant.slug through the existing route API contract
runtime.busy_semantics: second reload request is rejected locally while query.isFetching
runtime.truthful_success: success toast only after query.refetch resolves without error
runtime.truthful_failure: returned or thrown reread errors produce error feedback and never success
runtime.idempotency: repeatable read-only refresh; no server-side state created
